scope: Title-only medium/table1 initial trial. Larger bank0 headings, bank2 load rows and setup shadow activation are follow-on scopes.
art: Root approved genuine cubic V3 glyphs plus font-only native2x ordered coverage integration on2026-10-12. Original85 slots/76 visible;9 original blanks preserved. V2 chamfered geometry is superseded. Root approved isolated lowercase j dot-to-stem correction; all other84 slots and every original reviewed title output are byte-exact.
registration: Original width,height,top-left baseline and advance width+1; no crop/recenter; preserve local ascender blanks.

roles.caller: Exact original hue,value,tilde+4,clamp0..15; palette8 index255 is red and is not overridden.

rendering.order: For each menu row four whole-string diagonal color passes then foreground; after all rows replay selected foreground. Preserve overlapping descenders and ordered writes.
rendering.sampling: Canonical4x. At native2x keep title underlay nearest; for each2x2 canonical font group replay all ordered original glyph passes over the same nearest underlay RGB, resolving each live palette role first and using original integer source-over. Reduce final four RGB samples with(sum+2)//4. At native4x use unchanged canonical composition. Do not average palette indices, artwork, or each text pass separately. Other output sizes remain unapproved pending engineering.
rendering.unsupported: Entire text run stays classic for missing glyph85/extended/unreviewed bytes or unsupported context. Original blank slots must advance without ink. No global bank mutation.

compatibility.serialization: font_ascii256 signedLE32;85 metrics(width,height,width+1)u16;85 encoded(width,height,size)u16+RLE with no count/presence;85 eligibility bytes0/255;palette8 expandedRGB256 triples. No source RLE/RGB is distributed.

resource.reserved: u32 index14 and u64 index6/7 zero

provenance.method: Independently authored cubic centerlines with source-specific medium M/W arches and asymmetric V, rounded bowls and shoulders. Exact original metrics and blank slots. No original bitmap coverage is reused.
provenance.canonical_raster: Pillow12.3.0: sample each cubic at32 equal parameter intervals, exact full-precision control points; supersample32 logical; stroke round(1.90*32),butt endcaps,round joins,dot disks; exact original bbox clip; BOX downsample4x.
provenance.svg: Editable true-cubic SVG with explicit bbox clipping. Canonical numerical raster is rebuild.py.
